The unit generators are cynch. Generator has 11 kv 
generated 3937 amp 100 rpm, 50 HZ and 0.9 power factor

The generators has self excitation 240 v and 795 
amp. (static exc)

The first draft was initiated by eng. Mamdouh Aly Hassan, tested by eng. Mohamed 
Abd El Wahab El Dardir, accepted by general director eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Abd El 
Dayem, approved by eng. Mohamed Abd elbaset head sector of Aswan Dam 
(1&2) power stations and certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem HPGC MPIS 
coordinatori and inspection & quality control general director.

A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should 
 carry the suitable safety category

Maintenance staff should be well trained, qualified or directly supervised by
